steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Mephisto?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: What was that you just unleashed? Your... team is more riled up than before.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: They're... they're in pain.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Oh, you can tell? The seeds I planted have finally bloomed.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Nothing to worry about, Faust. They won't hurt us.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You're still catalyzing their infection?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Mephisto... just stop. We have a chance to survive.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I am the only one who can perform such Arts! And it is only through my Arts that we can escape!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You saw with your own eyes. If we push through like this, the L. G. D. will kill us all long before we can reach the escape tunnel in the slums!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Have you ever seen those weapons before? Nobody in Chernobog had weapons like that!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: This is their city, they know it far better than us! Where did they come from? Where do they disappear to?! There's no way we can take them on with this few of us!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The Chernobog Ursus are too weak... Lungmen treats us like an army, but we're no army. We're just a group of like-minded individuals trying to survive!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Quiet down. Morale is low enough.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But my herd will never waver in the face of such challenges!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...not to mention all the Reunion members who just joined us.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: FrostNova will definitely help us.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: FrostNova? That FrostNova?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Hah! Hahah! As if she didn't take her Yetis and betray us?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Mephisto!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: If not, we can definitely crush our enemies with such strength!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But even if they did turn against us, I can't blame them for doing what it takes to survive.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: FrostNova is no traitor. I told you. Look at the facts.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Indeed... we all do what it takes to survive.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Just calm down, and don't go stumbling into the L. G. D.'s traps!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I have it under control, Faust. I will ensure the comfortable survival of all my people.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: What...? What are you going to do?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I'm going to show the L. G. D. something much more terrifying than an army. Just wait until they see the flowers that bloom from my people.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Mephisto?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The L. G. D. must pay for their atrocities... And that Ch'en... She will pay for what she did to you!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: My comrades, my people, heed my words!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: A magnificent vitality flourishes within you... Go forth and give in to your impulses, spread your seed, and seize your future!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: No, Mephisto!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: They're living beings!

steps.name: Mephisto's Herd
steps.text: (Chaotic howling and shrieking).

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: All of Lungmen is your garden! Go, now, spread the life within you to all the people! Go, go, go!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Huh? What?! What's happening?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Wh- what are you doing? You're not in our squad!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...What did I ever do to you?! Or Mephisto...?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Captain? Captain?! Captaaaaaain!!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Agh! A- are you... trying to... BITE ME?! Why a- aaaaaaaaagh!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Help! Somebody help me!!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aaaaaaaaagh!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Heh heh...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: They are far stronger than they were.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: They can't hear my voice anymore, but they won't attack us again... They will grow stronger, more durable, and more numerous.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: And they will completely consume Lungmen. Hah. If my people can't have this city, I certainly won't leave it to the Lungmenites!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust, come, it's time...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: What have you done?

steps.name: Herd
steps.text: (Pained wailing).

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust? Where are you going?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Why are Mephisto's people attacking us?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I saw it... It.. It was awful... Those things took Ivan... And... And then Ivan became like them!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Suka! What are you... some kind of monster?! They feel no pain. I stab them and they don't die!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: They're getting stronger! We can't stop them!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Come with me!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Faust?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: No! It might be one of Mephisto's traps!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...He saved my life.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Mephisto's a piece of shit. He might be okay.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Get out of here. Hurry. The phantom crossbowmen will cover you.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Thanks... H- hey!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Look out!!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ——Originium...?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Run! The herd's after you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: GreyThroat, the enemies movements are erratic.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The defenders will hold the line, while the casters cut down the enemy numbers. You and the snipers will take care of any Infected with Arts ability.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'm allowed to shoot the Infected dead?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: GreyThroat...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In principle, I can't allow anyone to harm the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because, if I were to allow that, then wouldn't someone else allow the Infected to harm others? It's a vicious cycle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But it's pointless. There's no room for the philosophy of ethics on the battlefield.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The ideal situation is that nobody hurts anybody. Regardless of their infection status.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Gavial is providing medical support so... Watch yourself out there. Don't get hurt.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's that...? It looks like... Mephisto's herd...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... I can't sense any emotion from them?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: GreyThroat, get down! Something's wrong!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: They're... pulling Originium out of their bodies?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: GreyThroat!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doctor! Are you okay?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What's with this herd? They're acting completely different!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doesn't matter. You're safe here. Kinda. Don't move!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'll take care of them and be back in a sec!
